Reference / runtime/cbor

runtime/cbor#

The native layer under cbor (#1082): the calls that module makes into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under cbor (#1082): the calls that module makes into the host runtime. Programs use cbor instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

A decoded or built CBOR value is an immutable tree held by the runtime. Kind codes: 0 int, 1 float, 2 rat, 3 text, 4 bytes, 5 boolean, 6 null, 7 undefined, 8 simple, 9 array, 10 map, 11 tagged. A read of another kind, an index outside the node, a non-finite float read as a float or a tag number outside 0..2^64-1 is native invalid_input.

native cbor_decode#

native cbor_decode(origin is @byte, start is int, whole is bool, maximum_depth is int, maximum_items is int, maximum_size is int) is CborParseState

Decodes origin from byte start within the limits: the rest of origin is one item, or with whole false the first item of a CBOR sequence (RFC 8742). Offsets count from the start of origin.
